facts.fact: Libreinfo.net reports that on 15 December 2025 the government launched the e-acte-rccm.gov.bf platform, through which extracts, registration certificates and non-bankruptcy certificates from the commerce and mobile credit register can be obtained online.
CEFORE's creerentreprise.me.bf portal takes business-creation requests online, with the fee paid by Orange Money or Moov Money, and reports 6,916 requests from 1 January to 13 November 2026.
